description_en: Queries the Security Center agent installation code for a specified asset by UUID
description_zh: 通过UUID查询指定资产的云安全中心客户端安装码
name: GetInstallCodeForUuid

parameters.description_en:
The UUID of the server whose agent installation code you want to query.

> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
